tool: built-in image_gen; exact model ID not exposed
reference_policy: First accepted repair pin attached to every remaining generation.
technical_export: OpenCV contour tracing (1.4 source pixel tolerance), common repair alpha silhouette, 2px outline, exact flat semantic fills, glyph longest side82px. Godot SVG rasterization at4x then Lanczos128px. No embedded raster data in SVG.

jobs.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset: pin_repair, a flat game UI diagnostic map badge.
A clean ROUND circular badge, with a thin dark #2b2622 outline and a SHORT small triangular pointer tail attached at its bottom center. Solid uniform red #e63535 fill. White flat pictogram: a bold simple GEAR WITH A BROKEN TOOTH AND A CLEAR ZIGZAG CRACK through it. The broken gear must be recognizable at 20x20 pixels. Use only simple thick connected shapes, no fine mechanical detail. Pictogram occupies about 65% of badge diameter; strokes no thinner than 10 pixels at 128px delivery.
Front-facing orthographic 2D UI, no perspective. Keep the circular badge dominant and tail short, not a long teardrop silhouette. Symmetric outer silhouette centered, one icon only, transparent background. Final delivery 128x128 PNG and traced SVG, generate a crisp large square source. Border thickness equivalent to 2px at 128px. Badge fills canvas width with tiny clear padding, tail reaches bottom. Flat color regions suitable for vector tracing.
Avoid: text, letters, numbers, gradients, glossy, 3D, bevel, drop shadow, painterly, isometric building, background, multiple icons, watermark, thin lines, ornate detail.
